text:
Elemis's bestselling cleansing balms are now on sale at QVC(Image: Elemis)

It's always a treat to indulge in some new beauty goodies, but it's even better when they come with a hefty discount. And we've spotted a deal that lets shoppers get their hands on four luxurious Elemis cleansers worth £91 for less than £55.

QVC has reduced the Elemis 4-Piece Pro-Collagen Aromatic Cleansing Balm Collection to £54.96, down from £66, saving shoppers £11.04 - and free postage and packaging. However, the real bargain becomes clear when compared to buying the products individually from Elemis, where the collection would cost £91 in total - meaning beauty fans are saving an impressive £36.04. When broken down, the cleansers are £13.50 each.

What's more, new shoppers can get an extra £5 off with code FIVE4U when spending over £20.01. The cult cleanser has built up an impressive celebrity following over the years, with fans said to include Victoria Beckham, Kate Hudson and Catherine Zeta-Jones. The balms work hard to melt away makeup, daily grime and impurities without leaving skin feeling stripped or dry, transforming from a rich balm into a nourishing oil when mixed with water.

The collection includes two full-size (50g) versions of the brand's bestselling Pro-Collagen Cleansing Balms in the Original and Green Fig fragrances. It also features two 20g travel-sized editions in Rose and the newly launched Black Cherry scent.

Reviews-wise, the Pro-Collagen Cleansing Balms had lots of great feedback. A shopper via Elemis shared: "I've been using the Elemis Pro-Collagen Cleansing Balm for a while now, and I can see why it's so popular. It melts away makeup effortlessly and leaves my skin feeling clean, soft and hydrated. It also smells lovely and feels really luxurious."

The Elemis 4 Piece Pro-Collagen Aromatic Cleansing Balm Collection features aromatic blends including Green Fig, Rose and Black Cherry.

Meanwhile, someone else said: "I hardly ever purchase a beauty/skincare product a second time. Elemis cleansing balm is an exception.

"I was so worried I was about to run out, so I just received my second jar. It cleanses my skin so well and hydrates it. My skin is clean and plump. I'm 58 and super pleased with the product."

However, someone else wasn't a huge fan of the scent: "I had a travel size which I really loved, but I recently bought a larger size and the scent isn't as nice and I am disappointed with it, not sure why this is different."

For those who prefer a non-scented cleanser, Garnier's Micellar Cleansing Water (£5.49, Superdrug) is a great option. The cleanser is perfume-free and hypoallergenic, making it ideal for sensitive skin.

The NEOM Wellbeing 4 Piece Comforting Ritual Collection is currently 45% off at QVC(Image: NEOM/QVC)

The Elemis offer isn't the only beauty bargain currently available at QVC either. The retailer has also reduced the Neom Wellbeing 4-Piece Comforting Collection from £90 to £48.96, giving shoppers the chance to save more than £40.

Featuring the brand's popular Happiness fragrance, the set includes a one-wick candle, hand wash, hand lotion and a calming mist, making it an ideal self-care treat or gift. Otherwise, The White Company's Seychelles Home Scenting Gift Set (£65) is another gifting option, featuring the bestselling Seychelles Signature Candle, Room Spray and Diffuser.

Meanwhile, luxury bath and body brand Molton Brown has also been included in the QVC sale, with its four-piece hand wash and lotion collection reduced from £83 to £53. The collection elevates everyday routines with signature fragrances including Rosemary, White Mulberry, Petitgrain Dew and Blue Maquis.
